Hi Emily / CareWell security team,

Thanks for taking the SIG — attached is our completed SIG spreadsheet (redwood_SIG_answers_20260108.xlsx). I filled in conservative answers and flagged a few controls for which we'll need either a short call or additional artifacts.

Quick summary of the items I expect you'll want to review first:
- Data transfer mechanism: we currently support EU Standard Contractual Clauses and have a DPA template we use with enterprise customers.
- HIPAA/BAA: BAA is available for Redwood Private and Dedicated customers; for Hosted API customers we do offer a limited BAA in certain circumstances — happy to map this to CareWell's use case.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II (2025) is attached; data flow map and a short FAQ are also included.

As next steps, could you confirm:
1) Which deployment mode you expect to use (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)?
2) Any specific jurisdictions or residency requirements for PHI?
3) Who on your legal team should receive our draft DPA for redlines?

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute alignment call next week — propose Mon/Tue (Jan 12–13) morning PT.

Thanks, Priya — received and appreciate the level of detail. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) DPA/SCCs: Is your DPA built around SCC3 or the new EU SCCs (2021)? Do you have an execution-ready DPA we can review, or do you require our legal team to propose edits first?

2) HIPAA/BAA feasibility: CareWell will be storing limited PHI (patient IDs, timestamps, clinical notes excerpts) in model inputs. We need to understand whether using Redwood Hosted API would be permissible under your current BAA approach, or whether we must move to Dedicated/Private. Any examples of customers using Hosted+BAA would be helpful.

3) KMS/keys: We need details on key management (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed KMS) and whether HSM-backed keys are supported for encryption at rest.

4) Logs/audit: retention windows and whether audit logs containing user identifiers can be disabled or redacted.

Could we schedule that call on Tue, Jan 13 at 10am PT? I'll invite our security and legal ops folks.

On a related note, we'll also need your SOC 2 and any pen-test summaries — thanks for attaching those.

—Emily

Hi Emily — thanks for the good questions. I answered inline below and attached a short playbook and a draft DPA for your legal ops to review (draft_DPA_CareWell_20260111.docx).

1) DPA / SCCs: Our standard contract implements the 2021 EU SCCs (module-based flow) and we've updated our DPA to align with SCC3 where applicable. The attached draft DPA is execution-ready; please feel free to redline. If you prefer, we can have our legal counsel push a version to DocuSign once your team confirms counterparty details.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Short answer — we support BAAs for Dedicated and Private customers by default. For Hosted customers, we evaluate BAAs on a case-by-case basis depending on data classification and ingest patterns. Because you mentioned clinical notes excerpts, I recommend Dedicated capacity if you plan to send PHI at scale. We have a secure ingestion pipeline and can scope tokenization/pseudonymization patterns with your team.

3) KMS / keys: We support customer-managed keys (CMK) via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). HSM-backed key options are available for Private deployments; Dedicated customers can enable CMKs with key rotation policies.

4) Logs / audit: You can configure audit log retention per-route. For Dedicated/Private we can implement redaction or minimize PII in logs; for Hosted we retain request metadata by default for 30 days but can extend or redact per contract.

Attachments included: SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, data_flow_map_carewell.png, redwood_SIG_answers_20260108.xlsx, draft_DPA_CareWell_20260111.docx

If helpful, Dev can jump into the call to go over technical guardrails (Dev — can you confirm Tue Jan 13, 10am PT works?).

Thanks,
Priya

Emily — looping in Redwood legal. A couple of quick legal points to help your review team:

• For data transfer mechanism, we will propose the EU SCCs (2021). If you require another mechanism (e.g., adequacy decision reliance or specific local clauses), let us know.

Once you confirm entity details I'll send the DPA to DocuSign for signature and route the final executed copy into your shared folder.
